verses.1: Then the kingdom of the heavens will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.2: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.
verses.3: For the foolish ones had taken their lamps but had not taken oil with them,
verses.4: but the wise had taken oil in their jars along with their lamps.
verses.5: Now as the bridegroom was delayed, they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
verses.6: But at midnight there came a cry: "Here is the bridegroom! Come out to meet him."
verses.7: Then all those virgins got up and trimmed their lamps.
verses.8: The foolish ones said to the wise, "Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out."
verses.9: But the wise ones replied, "What if there is not enough for us and for you? Go rather to the merchants and buy some for yourselves."
verses.10: While they went away to buy it, the bridegroom came, and the ones who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.
verses.11: Later the others also came, saying, "Lord, Lord, open to us."
verses.12: But he replied, "Truly I tell you, I do not know you."
verses.13: Therefore, stay awake, for you do not know the day nor the hour.
verses.14: For it is like a man traveling abroad, who called his servants and entrusted his possessions to them.
verses.15: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to their ability. Then he went away.
verses.16: The one who received five talents went at once and traded with them and gained five more.
verses.17: Likewise, the one who received two gained two more.
verses.18: But the one who received one went away and dug a hole in the ground and hid his master's silver.
verses.19: After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
verses.20: The one who had received five talents came forward and presented five more, saying, "Lord, you gave me five talents; here, I have gained five more."
verses.21: His master said to him, "Well done, good and faithful servant. You were faithful with a little; I will put you in charge of much. Enter into the joy of your master."
verses.22: The one who had received two came forward and said, "Lord, you gave me two talents; here, I have gained two more."
verses.23: His master said, "Well done, good and faithful servant. You were faithful with a little; I will put you in charge of much. Enter into the joy of your master."
verses.24: The one who had received one came forward and said, "Lord, I knew you were a harsh man, reaping where you did not sow and gathering where you did not scatter seed.
verses.25: So I was afraid and went and hid your talent in the ground. Here you have what is yours."
verses.26: His master replied, "You wicked and lazy servant! You knew that I reap where I did not sow and gather where I did not scatter.
verses.27: You should have deposited my money with the bankers, and on my return I would have received it with interest.
verses.28: So take the talent away from him and give it to the one who has ten talents.
verses.29: For to everyone who has, more will be given, and he will have an abundance. But from the one who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
verses.30: And throw out the useless servant into the outer darkness; there he will weep and gnash his teeth."
verses.31: When the Son of Man comes in his glory and all the angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verses.32: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate them from one another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats,
verses.33: and he will place the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
verses.34: Then the king will say to those on his right, "Come, you who are blessed by my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world.
verses.35: For I was hungry and you gave me food, I was thirsty and you gave me drink, a stranger and you welcomed me,
verses.36: naked and you clothed me, sick and you visited me, in prison and you came to me."
verses.37: Then the righteous will answer him, saying, "Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you drink?
verses.38: When did we see you a stranger and welcome you, or naked and clothe you?
verses.39: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?"
verses.40: Then the king will answer them, "Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers of mine, you did for me."
verses.41: Then he will say to those on the left, "Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
verses.42: For I was hungry and you gave me no food, I was thirsty and you gave me no drink,
verses.43: a stranger and you did not welcome me, naked and you did not clothe me, sick and in prison and you did not visit me."
verses.44: Then they will answer, saying, "Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison and did not help you?"
verses.45: Then he will answer them, "Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me."
verses.46: And these will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life."
